title: Human Services Practicum: An Equity Lens
description: This text is designed to be used in fieldwork seminar courses that generally accompany students’ internship experience. Topics include issues that students will most likely face during their fieldwork. The text begins with early internship issues of getting to know the agency and becoming part of a team. Later chapters address topics including effective supervision, ethical dilemmas, and working with an equity lens.
authors: Yvonne M. Smith - Author / Sally Guyer - Author / Ivan Mancinelli-Franconi - Author / Elizabeth B. Pearce - Author
